SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of teamwork is enhanced through discussing the importance of brushing their

teeth regularly.

• Learning to learn: the skill of working collaboratively through discussing the importance of brushing their teeth regularly in

small groups.

• Self-efficacy: as learners individually demonstrate how to brush their teeth and recite/sing song/qasida/poem on brushing

teeth.
